How to use this template

- Fill in every applicable section. Delete a section that does not apply rather
  than leaving it empty or writing "None" under it.
- Description is prose: say what is missing or wrong today, and why it matters.
  Do not restate the title.
- Requirements are acceptance criteria, one per bullet, phrased so each can be
  checked. Keep them implementation-agnostic: say what must be true, not which
  file changes.
- Open Questions is for decisions you want input on before work starts. Delete
  the section if there are none.
- Cite related issues inline in the prose, for example "Depends on vote count
  being available; see #74". Do not add a "Related Issues" heading.
-->
